description: This is a Python source file defining a database engine specification class for Denodo within the Superset project. It includes error pattern definitions, configuration parameters, time grain expressions, and methods for data type conversion and epoch handling.

classes.name: _ErrorPatterns
classes.description: Internal class defining regex patterns for various error messages related to database connection and query errors.

classes.name: DenodoEngineSpec
classes.description: Class representing the Denodo database engine specification, including connection details, error handling, and data type conversions.

methods.name: epoch_to_dttm
methods.description: Returns the SQL expression to convert epoch milliseconds to a datetime.

methods.name: convert_dttm
methods.description: Converts a Python datetime object to a database-specific date or timestamp string based on target type.

methods.name: get_datatype
methods.description: Returns the data type name for a given psycopg2 type code.
